summary: AI gateways and observability products expose token and cost accounting, but a robust budget also needs task-aware reservations, hard enforcement and an explicit degraded path when the allowance is exhausted.

items.text: Portkey AI Gateway budget limits: API keys can enforce cost or token ceilings with alert thresholds and periodic resets; provider integrations and workspaces have related budget controls.
LiteLLM Proxy: central spend tracking, budgets and rate limits can apply policy across model providers.
Langfuse token and cost tracking: trace-level usage makes budget consumption observable and supports model-specific pricing configuration.
